title: Setup page alignment: one clear flow, moves apply to the body as it is, and picks you can actually see

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
Reported by the maintainer while hand-testing the setup page's part alignment (screenshot of the Setups page attached in chat: Part alignment dropdown at the top, then "Lay on a plane - pick a face", "pick three points", "Axes in the plane - pick an edge or two points").

## What's wrong

1. **The "Part alignment" control at the top overrides the pickers.** The dropdown and the Turn X/Y/Z + about + Apply row sit above the face, three-point and edge/two-point pickers, and applying one wipes out what the others did. It's unclear which one is in charge. The page should read as one flow, where the pickers are the way to align and the preset/turn row doesn't silently override them (or is clearly a separate "start from a preset" step).
2. **Each pick-driven move resets the part and then moves it.** Laying on a face, on three points or applying axes first returns the body to its import pose and then applies only the new transform. Expected: each move applies **to the body as it is now** (incremental, composed with what was done before), and undo steps back one move at a time.
3. **Pick status shows internal ids.** "Face 0xccc7c…" (the welded-face id) means nothing to a user. Show the count and the kind: "1 face selected", "2 points selected", "1 edge selected".
4. **Picked geometry is hard to see.**
   - **Faces:** only the outline is drawn in purple. Fill the whole picked face with the pick colour (semi-transparent), so it's obvious which face it is.
   - **Vertices / points:** draw them as round, visible markers (filled discs, somewhat transparent is fine), not a speck.
   - **Edges:** the picked edge line is so thin it barely shows against the grey part. Draw it noticeably thicker (bold).

## Related
- #692 (one picking rule for the whole app: what is pickable). This issue is about how picks are *shown* and how the alignment page *applies* them.
- #330, #555, #557, #606 (lay on a face, three-point plane, axes by edge/two points, align about the WCS origin): the features this page combines.
- #701 (WCS from picked features with roles).

## Done means
- Applying a face, three-point or axis alignment moves the part from its current pose; a pinning test applies two alignments in a row and checks the second composes on the first, and undo restores each step.
- The top "Part alignment" preset/turn row no longer silently discards a picker's result (pinned by a test, or the page is restructured so the two can't conflict); the flow is described in the page's tooltips.
- Pick status reads "N face(s)/edge(s)/point(s) selected", with no internal ids (structural test).
- Picked faces are filled with the pick colour, picked points are round markers, and picked edges are drawn bold. Checked by the structural/paint assertions where they can be, hand-tested by the maintainer otherwise (no snapshot PNG changes in the PR).
